capabilities: Show tasks dated with an emoji date and a follow-up tag on a calendar
Keep checkbox lines and calendar ticks in sync in both directions
Paste live calendar blocks into any note, including a list-only view
Roll recurring tasks forward to the next date on completion
Filter items by who-handles-it markers for you versus an AI assistant
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual from release files.
problem: Obsidian has no calendar that shows dated tasks, so follow-ups scattered across notes are hard to see and tick off by day.

relations.evidence: If an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, …) works in your vault, give it these instructions.

summary: Calendar for follow-up tasks stored as tagged Markdown checkbox lines, with a hub note and pasteable live calendar blocks.
